answer: Because the declaration is checked against funding history rather than taken on trust, the zephyr registry records each claim and the island audit publishes every slash. A farm must thus either lie, which the harbor graph proves on replay, or recruit 185 outsiders whose stake is exposed alongside its own. Attesters sign a declaration that they hold no common funding with the identity they attest, and a later finding of common funding voids the attestation and slashes 52% of the attester's bond. That is 10 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
